craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. Natures kit stated fairly; green-brought-about kept vivid. Rejected: (a) green→sprout → killed: green shows. Read aloud: NO-world-PLAN … BRINGS-green a-BOUT.

lines: No world-plan makes the seed put forth the sprout;
blind nature — kit and cause — brings green about.

reads_against.argmap: Seed to sprout — by what purpose? → Nature's kit suffices — the svabhāva position stated.
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
reads_against.c1_rasa: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn
